verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a GitHub Marketplace app listing, "Connect your code without leaving Slack," within GitHub's integration ecosystem. It suggests a Slack integration but does not explicitly describe repository or pull request notifications, and nothing shows it is first-party. missing for 10: explicit docs on repo/PR notification delivery to Slack, any evidence for Discord or Microsoft Teams, notification configuration/filtering details, first-party documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
